title: P0c: scorecard efficiency metrics — tokens and cost per accepted task and goal (fix-round lineage collapsed), tokens and time to first green, time to accepted, first-pass success rate, fix-round rate and average, fix-round tokens, calls and turns per accepted task, model distribution, pipeline amplification with the nine-bucket breakdown, grouping by goal, executor, complexity band, task class and role, unknown bucket; CLI scorecard --efficiency
spec:
Phase I P0 (brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md, section P0 metrics and amplification). Base goal/T-0445 after P0a (T-0449: row fields bucket, lineage_root, round_index, band, task_class, executor, model, normalized tokens, usd, usd_source; Jev rows with task and bucket) and P0b (T-0450: created_at, pipeline.first_green_at, gate_attempts, gate_reds, lineage_fix_rounds, accepted_at) merge. Scout facts: scorecard.build is per executor from execute rows (scorecard.py:186-249); by_task (403), by_goal (471), tokens_per_accepted_goal (637) and usd_per_accepted_goal (654) exist from G1b and H1; _tokens_of (381) keeps the discounted cache-read convention and _legacy_total_only (395) handles pre-normalisation rows; Jev rows are read by jev_footer (359) from runs/jev; the H1 rule: a ratio with zero denominator is None and renders n/a. CLI wiring for scorecard lives in cli.py (136, 237).
1. scorecard.efficiency(root=STATE, by=None) -> dict. Rows = runs/*.jsonl plus runs/jev/*.jsonl (bucket jev). Attribute every row to a task lineage root (row.lineage_root, else row.task, else unknown) and to a goal (row.goal_id, else the task's parent, else unknown). An accepted task is an execute lineage root whose task has merged_into set (its accepted_at when present). An accepted goal is one whose GOAL task has a pr_url or result with pr_url (reuse accepted_goals(), scorecard.py:621).
Per accepted task: tokens (sum of total_tokens using _tokens_of over every row attributed to the lineage: execute, fix_round, spec_review, review, challenge rows whose task or inputs[0] is in the lineage, jev rows keyed by lineage tasks), cost (usd sum), tokens_to_first_green (rows with ts <= root first_green_at), time_to_first_green_s (first_green_at - created_at), time_to_accepted_s (accepted_at - created_at), calls (row count), turns (sum turns), fix_rounds (lineage_fix_rounds), fix_round_tokens (bucket fix_round rows), first_pass (first_green_at present and lineage_fix_rounds == 0 and gate_reds == 0). Missing stamps make the specific metric None, never a crash.
Per accepted goal: the sums over its accepted tasks plus planner rows (bucket planner with goal_id) and scout rows for that goal, with tokens_per_accepted_goal and usd_per_accepted_goal kept consistent with the existing functions (add a test that the new goal total equals tokens_per_accepted_goal for a fixture).
Rates over accepted tasks: first_pass_rate, fix_round_rate (share with fix_rounds >= 1), avg_fix_rounds, median and max tokens per accepted task, model_distribution (rows and tokens per model per bucket).
Amplification: breakdown = tokens per bucket in the fixed order Planner, Scout, Execution (bucket execute, initial runs only), Fix rounds, Spec review, Code review, Challenge, Jev, Other (bucket other or memory or unattributed) plus Total; pipeline_amplification = Total / Execution, None when Execution is 0. Computed for the whole window and per group.
by in {None, goal, executor, band, class, role}: groups accepted tasks (role groups rows instead) and reports the per-group rates, medians, breakdown and amplification. An unknown group ("unknown") collects rows without a task or goal and is always shown with its token total so nothing silently disappears.
2. CLI: orchestrator scorecard --efficiency [--by goal|executor|band|class|role] [--json] renders a text table (metric, value per group) with n/a for None and a footer with the breakdown and amplification; --json dumps the dict. Existing scorecard flags unchanged.
3. Documentation strings in scorecard.py name each formula; README is P0d's job.
Tests (tests/test_scorecard.py with synthetic runs and tasks fixtures, tests/test_cli.py for the CLI): test_efficiency_collapses_fix_round_lineage_into_root, test_efficiency_first_pass_and_fix_round_rates, test_efficiency_tokens_and_time_to_first_green_use_stamps, test_efficiency_missing_stamps_give_none_not_crash, test_efficiency_amplification_breakdown_sums_to_total_and_none_at_zero_execution, test_efficiency_unknown_bucket_is_reported, test_efficiency_goal_total_matches_tokens_per_accepted_goal, test_efficiency_group_by_band_class_executor_role, test_efficiency_model_distribution, test_cli_scorecard_efficiency_text_and_json. Existing scorecard and cli tests stay green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A; commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: scorecard.efficiency returns every metric in the brief's P0 list with None for undefined values and an unknown bucket; the breakdown order is Planner, Scout, Execution, Fix rounds, Spec review, Code review, Challenge, Jev, Other, Total, Amplification
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
